experiments.title: CAMELYON whole-slide metastasis search — Astra medium

current.assessment_reason: CAMELYON 4/6 polygon-hit fraction overweights two unhit small Tumor polygons: they lie 24.4 and 32.0 micrometers from already-hit polygons and together occupy 0.91% of annotated Tumor polygon area. The solver-facing task asks for metastatic-tissue points and explicitly disavows polygon count as lesion count, while the scorer requires a point in every withheld polygon. Retain the frozen 4/6; review lesion grouping and endpoint before interpreting this as lesion-search sensitivity or promoting the task.

TIGER tissue-conditioned cell count — Astra medium

current.assessment_reason: TIGER tissue-supplied matched-compartment scoring has a hidden boundary convention: the solver instruction assigns codes to submitted centers, but the scorer checks the mask at the matched source-cell center. Two of 380 matched cells are scored wrong despite their codes equaling the supplied mask at the submitted centers, 1.4 and 3.6 pixels from source centers. Preserve the frozen 378/380 result; specify the convention or revise a future task before promotion.
